versions.changelog: Round 24: deep fragmentation analysis and redundancy governance

Initial release of Calendar Reminder Free — provides personal Outlook calendar scanning and Feishu notifications.

- Scans next-day Outlook calendar events automatically every night at 22:00 (Asia/Shanghai timezone).
- Sends Feishu reminders: morning events get 2-hour advance alerts, afternoon events receive a summary at 12:00.
- Supports cron-based scheduling via skill-platform CLI, as well as manual runs.
- Designed for individual daily schedule reminders; more features (multi-channel, timezone handling, team sharing) available in the paid version.
- Includes detailed setup instructions, configuration guidance, troubleshooting steps, and real-world usage examples.
